items.title: From insight to action: improving infrastructure risk posture with Terraform and Concert
items.summary: Learn how Terraform and IBM Concert connect trusted infrastructure context, policy-driven governance, and vulnerability management to improve risk posture across the infrastructure lifecycle.

items.title: Consul 2.1.0: Advancing secure, resilient connectivity for modern and agentic applications
items.summary: Consul 2.1.0 helps organizations simplify application access, strengthen networking resilience and security, modernize the underlying connectivity stack, and extend trusted connectivity to emerging AI workloads.

items.title: Migrate Sentinel and OPA policies to Terraform policy faster with the Terraform policy agent
items.summary: Use the Terraform policy agent to convert existing Sentinel and OPA policies into tested Terraform policies. Run it in a container with the model provider you choose.

items.title: Secure AI credentials from discovery to remediation with Vault Radar and Vault
items.summary: AI credentials can easily spread across development workflows. Learn how Vault Radar and Vault help teams find, remediate, and securely manage them.
